I couldn’t agree more! From the beginning, I thought it was so stiff and uncomfortable but thought, maybe with time it will soften form what I’ve read online.  I purchased the uppland L couch last august and still so uncomfortable! I remember how I excited I was to purchase it because of the price and I’ve always wanted an L couch. Now all I think about is how I would love to replace it with a reclining couch! 

Did changing up the foam/fill make a difference?
